aboutGame.title: What Is PS5 Emulation on PC?
paragraphs: KytyPS5 is a PlayStation 5 translation project; AnyPS5 provides tools for porting executables. Their project repositories link compatibility reports and explain their respective approaches.

This fan wiki helps readers find those sources and evaluate their limits. A project screenshot, boot result and completed playthrough are different kinds of evidence. We do not present an independently tested game or FPS database.

faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about PS5 emulation.

items.question: Is there a working PS5 Emulator for PC?
items.answer: KytyPS5 and AnyPS5 are active projects with public per-title progress reports. Check the exact project, game and build; this wiki does not certify a universal playable library.

items.question: Is PCSX5 real?
items.answer: No — it is the genre's most famous fake: a scam brand wearing an emulator's name. Every site promising a finished PS5 emulator that runs all games is a scam, with zero exceptions in the genre's history.

items.question: What hardware do I need?
items.answer: Use the requirements in the named project repository and a matching game report. This wiki has not independently tested a GPU performance curve.

items.question: Is PS5 emulation legal?
items.answer: The emulator is legal; your usage decides everything else. Games and firmware must be your own, dumped from your own console — no legitimate project distributes either, and neither does this site.
